description: B7 SAVED AT BATCH48'S RELEASES, AFTER ONE UPDATE ALL (PLUGIN-UPDATE-ALL; docs/reference-parts/buildings.md B7, docs/BACKLOG.md PLUGIN-UPDATE-ALL): b7-outline's tree (B7's 288 x 192 outline sketch, loft.floor 1.2.0, loft.wall 1.3.0 on the floor, the door and five windows at 1.1.0, loft.roof 1.4.0) with every Build feature updated to its newest release by loft_plugins.updates: the floor at 1.3.0 on Joists bear on 'Long walls' (1.2.0's floor byte for byte), the walls at 1.4.0, the openings at 1.5.0 (each header filled with a middle 2x6 ply and two 1/2 in plywood spacers) and the roof at 1.6.0 with its default ceiling joists, one 2x8 beside each of the 11 inner common pairs. It is B7 built fresh today, member for member. model.json is EXACTLY the sketch and the expansions with their member materials; members.json is each body's member metadata with its plugin (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_update_all.py pins both; services/geometry/tests/test_update_all_b7.py checks the STEP, interference and the mass).
derivation: INDEPENDENT of the plugins: services/geometry/tests/test_update_all_b7.py builds test_opening_update_b7.script() (B7's independent build123d script plus each opening's middle ply and two spacers, 235 solids) and test_ceiling_joists_b7.joists() (11 joists typed from buildings.md, the (Y, Z) hexagon of b7-ceiling-joists extruded X c + 0.75 .. c + 2.25 for c = 24 .. 264). The STEP matches the 246 solids solid for solid (volume to 1e-4 in^3, bounds to 1e-5 in).
surface_area, centroid, mass_g and center_of_mass are the script's solids summed (expected_numbers()): spf_lumber 450, southern_pine_pt 582, osb 641 and plywood 577 kg/m^3.
bounding_box: b7-outline's: the plies, spacers and joists all lie inside it.

topology and MESH from the script's B-rep: b7-opening-update's 1 628 faces, 3 474 edges and 235 shells plus 11 joists of 8 faces and 18 edges: 1 716 faces, 3 672 edges, 246 shells; every face is planar, so a face of n edge-vertices on h holes meshes as n + 2h - 2 triangles on n vertices: 6 948 + 11 x 36 = 7 344 vertices and 3 692 + 11 x 20 = 3 912 triangles. The kernel's build of model.json meets every count exactly.

Interference none (test_nothing_interferes probes every pair whose boxes overlap, exactly): the spacers meet their plies face to face, and each joist meets its rafter face to face and stands on the eave walls' top plates.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), as b7-ceiling-joists' bound. The bounds are ABSOLUTE and the part is ~4.76e9 mm^3 summed over 246 bodies, so the double-precision sum carries round-off of a few ULPs of the sum (~9.5e-7 each): the kernel differs from the script by +6.7e-06 mm^3 on the volume, -3.0e-07 mm^2 on the area, <= 1.4e-12 mm on the centroid, <= 5.9e-12 mm on the centre of mass and 1.4e-09 g on the mass, b7-ceiling-joists' summation class over 18 more boxes. 2e-5 is 3x the volume's measured order; one joist missed takes 34 096 000 mm^3, one spacer 22 600 000 and one snip left square 640 mm^3, so any fails by seven orders or more.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, b7-outline's class, measured 2026-10-29: OCCT's STEP writer rounds the 26 sloped rafters', the notched OSB panels' and the 11 snipped joists' irrational coordinates. Round-trip drift: volume -2.90e-4 mm^3, area -2.64e-5 mm^2, centroid <= 1.4e-10 mm, inside b7-ceiling-joists' -3.19e-4 (whose build123d twin drifts -3.76e-4, so it is OCCT's STEP, not Loft's export); the 18 header plies and spacers are boxes and add nothing. 1e-3 is 3.4x the measured drift and the b2-roof goldens' bound; it applies to volume and area only, the centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
